band.basis: Auckland, GST exclusive. Distinct components summed: conduit (QV $34.70/m, +15% high for HD orange grade) + cable material (web $2.98/m) + draw-in labour (QV electrician rate x judged hours) + 16 terminations (QV rate x judged hours + material allowance) + testing/BMS interface/labelling (QV rate x judged hours) + scaffold hire (QV $397/wk) + sundries allowance. Per-job items amortised across the 200m nominal: 200m total = $9,450 (low) / $13,100 (high), centre approx $11,300. Main cost driver (conduit, ~65% of total) is a cited QV row, so the band is established. Confidence LOW: the QV conduit row's inclusions are unstated (possible small duplication of draw-wire) and the terminations/testing hours are judgement anchored to a cited hourly rate; allowances plus judgement-hours are under one-third of the total.

band.unit: NZ$ per lineal metre of installed cable route (Auckland, ex GST)
band.basis: Sum of distinct components (no component is included in another): cable supply 3.33-3.89 + conduit 34.70-60.00 + drawing-in 1.68-3.35 + termination labour 3.35-5.02 + glands 1.13 + termination sundries 0.60-1.30 + testing/BMS interface 3.35-6.69 + labelling 0.75-2.00 + scaffold 1.99-3.97 = $50.88-$87.35/m. Total for the 200m nominal quantity: $10,176 (low) to $17,470 (high), midpoint ~$13,800. Auckland, ex GST, ex preliminaries, margin, design and consent. Main cost drivers (20mm PVC conduit and the instrumentation cable) are sourced (QV row + two NZ supplier pages). Allowances and QS-estimated labour quantities are ~25% of the mid total. Confidence is LOW: QV rows are unreviewed, and the same conduit description appears at both $34.70/m and $60.00/m with no stated inclusions, which alone drives most of the band width.

band.unit: $/m of installed control/instrumentation cable route (cable route incl. containment)
band.basis: Sum of distinct components, GST exclusive, no preliminaries, margin or design. Nominal quantity 200m in 8 runs (avg 25m); all per-m figures are the 200m total / 200. Low = $12,673 total; High = $17,204 total; mid ~$74.7/m (~$14,940 total). Dominant driver is the QV 20mm conduit row (40-55% of total). Confidence low: QV rows are UNREVIEWED, the cable-install line is a proxy with a stated uplift, and the QV Conduits table contains two identical-text 20mm rows at $34.70 and $60.00 (material/difficulty unstated). Allowances carry ~26% of the low total and ~38% of the high total - above one third at the high end - because no published NZ rates exist for instrumentation terminations, BMS point testing or cable drawing-in.
